title: Playing ball and Allie Sherman
summary: Talk of his love of sports leads to his friendship with his brother's friend Allie Sherman.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: You have a reputation as something of a ball player too and you keep referring to going and playing ball then. Over your later professional life, you were big on softball if I remember correctly.
I was big on a lot of sports. I loved to play ball. But we grow old. Who was that guy--
We were kids then, dear. That was Allie Sherman, he became the coach of the New
You grew up together over in Brooklyn?
He was my kid brother's friend, he lived in the same building that we did.
And you taught him to play football?
I didn't teach him to play football.
I like that better; that could be a headline on the tape.
I used to practice with him during the day. Yeah, I could have taught him I guess; sounds good though.
He's not going to come back and argue about it.
